findings.title: Wrong event listener removed in dispose
findings.body: The `dispose` method removes the `message` event listener bound to `this.onMessage` instead of the `close` event listener bound to the same handler. The `onClose` handler remains attached, causing a memory leak and incorrect cleanup. Remove the `close` listener bound to `this.onMessage`.

summary.problem: The dispose method incorrectly removes the message event listener instead of the close event listener, leaving the onClose handler attached and causing a memory leak.
summary.done_well: The dispose method structure and event listener removal pattern are consistent with the file's existing style.
